description: Build a TouchDesigner bridge surface for an external SAM2/FastSAM segmentation service. Creates source input, mask receiver, mask_out, matte_out, preview_out, and clear notes that no model is bundled.

active.description: Start request/polling endpoints active. Default is off for artist validation.

bridge_mode.description: External mask transport used by the SAM2/FastSAM service.

input_top_path.description: Optional source TOP path. When provided it is pulled into the container via a Select TOP.

mask_source_name.description: NDI/Syphon/Spout sender name that publishes the segmentation mask.

name.description: Container name for the bridge under parent_path.

parent_path.description: COMP that will receive the SAM2/FastSAM bridge container.

prompt_mode.description: Prompt style expected by the external SAM2/FastSAM service.

server_url.description: External SAM2/FastSAM service URL or WebSocket endpoint.

watch_folder.description: Folder used by file_watch mode for externally rendered mask images.

name: create_sam2_segmentation_bridge
title: Create SAM2 segmentation bridge
